newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Constran unit defaults on debt - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Constran unit defaults on debt - report.

text.p: Constran International Ltd, a Cayman Islands subsidiary of Brazil's Constran S.A. Construcoes e Comercio, failed to make a $13 million payment on its euro-commercial paper program on Tuesday, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said.

Constran International, which is also part of Brazil's Grupo Itamarati, controlled by businessman Olacyr de Moraes, is scheduled to make a $22 million payment in December and a $20 million payment in February on the commercial paper program, Gazeta said.
The paper, citing the European financial agency Euroclear, said the payments were all part of a $55 million commercial paper program.
Gazeta said the payments were guaranteed by Constran S.A. and by Grupo Itamarati.
Neither was immediately available for comment.
